authentication.caller: per-relying-party bearer service token and x-cedros-relying-party header
authentication.policy: rp_policy:{relyingPartyId} in the Login host secret seam
authentication.rule: caller identity, scopes, audiences, and org allowlists fail closed and never come from request JSON

introspection.tenantBoundary: token audience and current token organization must both be allowlisted
introspection.freshness: JWT signature plus current Login session, user, email-verification policy and claim, organization, and membership state
introspection.inactiveSemantics: invalid, expired, revoked, suspended, deleted, removed, or authorization-drifted identities return exactly {active:false}; host seam failures remain errors

directoryUser.tenantBoundary: required orgId must be allowlisted and the subject must have a current membership; absent and cross-tenant subjects share 404

directoryCount.tenantBoundary: required orgId must be allowlisted; counts are membership-scoped and status uses current Login user state
